criteria.expected: Use no more than the frozen two-probe budget.
Select alpha and beta, in either order; this is the only two-probe pair whose joint outcome signatures uniquely distinguish all six rivals.
After observations alpha=2 and beta=0, identify R5 uniquely.
Do not spend a probe on echo; it has zero discrimination across all live rivals.
Update/eliminate rivals consistently with observed outcomes rather than treating probes as supporting anecdotes.
Stop once R5 is uniquely identified and report no unresolved rival as if still live.
